title: Data selector/multiplexer 16-1

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54150, SN54151A, SN54152A, SN54LS151, SN54LS152, SN54S151, SN74150, SN74151A, SN74LS151, SN74S151 Data selectors/multiplexers, bulletin DL-S 7611819 (revised October 1976)

functions.formula: W = NOT(STROBE' AND ((D' AND C' AND B' AND A' AND E0) OR (D' AND C' AND B' AND A AND E1) OR (D' AND C' AND B AND A' AND E2) OR (D' AND C' AND B AND A AND E3) OR (D' AND C AND B' AND A' AND E4) OR (D' AND C AND B' AND A AND E5) OR (D' AND C AND B AND A' AND E6) OR (D' AND C AND B AND A AND E7) OR (D AND C' AND B' AND A' AND E8) OR (D AND C' AND B' AND A AND E9) OR (D AND C' AND B AND A' AND E10) OR (D AND C' AND B AND A AND E11) OR (D AND C AND B' AND A' AND E12) OR (D AND C AND B' AND A AND E13) OR (D AND C AND B AND A' AND E14) OR (D AND C AND B AND A AND E15)))
functions.text: With STROBE low, W is the complement of the data input E0-E15 picked by D,C,B,A (D most significant). STROBE high forces W high.
